data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
(None — infrastructure gate task; enables dd-2 precondition 'executes only after attested.json present'.)

Add gate subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/stale_band.py. Accepts --pass <N>. Reads bridge_state/bootstrap/stale-syncs-<pass>.attested.json. Extracts attesting commit SHA and manifest hash. Calls verify_attested_commit() from _attestation.py (task-1). Verifies attested manifest hash matches current stale-syncs-<pass>.manifest.json content hash. Exits 0 if both checks pass, non-zero otherwise. NO Jira API calls. Pure verification.

## TDD Test Spec
Given valid reviewer-signed attestation with matching manifest hash; Then gate exits 0. Given bot self-attesting identity; Then exits non-zero. Given attested.json absent; Then exits non-zero. Given manifest hash in attested.json does not match current manifest; Then exits non-zero.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Implement stale_band.py gate subcommand verifying reviewer attestation
